messages:
Alex Chen: paging in the middle of Monday morning, great :grimace:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service 'inference-prod' (service id: svc-77f4). Trigger: high-error-rate (5xx) - threshold breached. Link: https://pd.example/incident/INC-8892
PagerDuty: incident INC-8892 created and routed to 'platform-oncall'
Maria Patel: wait, platform-oncall? that doesn't sound right. inference-prod should route to 'inference-oncall'
Samir Rao: confirmed, the PD service binding for inference-prod is currently set to team:platform-oncall. that's wrong. looking into who changed it.
Jordan Kim: @Samir any idea when that binding was changed? customers are seeing 502s per monitoring. we're getting a steady 40% error rate on /v1/generate
Samir Rao: checking audit logs... `pd bindings audit --service svc-77f4 --since 24h` shows last change at 2332999000 by automation user 'ops-scheduler' (cron: schedule-sync).
Alex Chen: ops-scheduler? oh no. that was supposed to sync shadow schedules but not rebind services.
Maria Patel: if platform-oncall gets the page we'll get delayed ack because they're handling infra. this explains slow triage. customers impacted: some users seeing timeouts and degraded throughput.
Samir Rao: temporary mitigation: re-route PD service to inference-oncall and mute escalation to avoid duplicate noise. will run `pd service update svc-77f4 --team inference-oncall` and mute rule for 10m.
IncidentBot: muted escalation for INC-8892 for 10m per request by Samir Rao
Jordan Kim: while that's happening i'm going to scale up inference replicas and revert the last deploy from 22:58 to see if it's a release regression. deploy bot: rolling revert initiated.
Alex Chen: good. also push a short status note to #support: "We are investigating increased 5xx on inference endpoints; mitigation in progress; some customers may see degraded responses."
Maria Patel: sent. @support please forward any high-priority customer reports to me.
PagerDuty: INC-8892 reassigned to team 'inference-oncall' (oncall user: maria.p)
Maria Patel: acked INC-8892 :white_check_mark: starting investigation - checking model-serving logs and GPU host metrics.
Samir Rao: noticed a masked error: model-worker xla failed to mount KV cache intermittently after GC spikes. tail of kube logs: ```
E0321 07:14:32.123 model-worker] CacheMountError: timeout mounting /kvcache
E0321 07:14:32.125 model-worker] Retrying (3/5)```
Jordan Kim: revert didn't change the error pattern. scaling helped reduce tail latency but not the mount failures.
Alex Chen: ok plan B: roll a hotfix to increase mount retry/timeout and add backoff. Can we get a patch out in the next 20m?
Maria Patel: I'll coordinate a canary patch to one zone first. @Samir can you prepare the config change?
Samir Rao: done, patch built. canary deploy started. I'll watch logs and metrics.
IncidentBot: INC-8892 update: escalated to Level 2 per policy (unresolved for 15m). Pages sent to on-call backup.
Alex Chen: pinging execs with short blurb, minimal details: "Mitigating increased errors on inference API; mitigation in flight; customer impact limited to requests timing out."
Maria Patel: canary looks stable for 5m, errors reduced 90% on that subset. promoting to 50% rollout.
Jordan Kim: reenable auto-scaling and increase KV cache GC thresholds to avoid thrashing post-patch.
Samir Rao: housekeeping note: ops-scheduler sync job has a bug that overwrote service binding when schedules changed. creating PR to scope shadow-sync to schedules only and add a PD binding dry-run.
Alex Chen: good. after we stabilize, we need a quick postmortem: root cause (scheduler bug), customer impact (partial API degradation, timeouts), mitigation (rebind service, mute, canary hotfix), follow-ups (fix scheduler, PD binding guard, runbook update for pages).
Maria Patel: agreed. I'll open the incident ticket in our tracker and tag SRE+Platform.
Samir Rao: PR opened: https://gh.example/r/redwood/ops-scheduler/pull/542 - tests included.
Jordan Kim: last check - metrics look healthy and PD is quiet. closing the page once we verify 30m of normal ops.
IncidentBot: INC-8892 status: acknowledged -> investigating -> mitigation in progress.
Maria Patel: marking INC-8892 as resolved (will monitor) :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: thanks everyone. follow-up: add a PD binding validation to pre-merge checks for ops-scheduler.
Maria Patel: adding to action items.
PagerDuty: incident INC-8892 resolved by Maria Patel at 2333000180
